topics.name: Iran war and Hormuz
topics.now: The United States carried out limited strikes on Iranian air defenses on Qeshm island on November 6, the first since the midterms, while President Trump said talks with Tehran had made progress and Qatar urged a deal. A third US carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, is due in the Arabian Sea in mid-November, and a seafarer was killed in a tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz on November 5.

topics.now: The central bank's dollar selling rate ended the week of November 5 at EGP 54.01, the pound's strongest in at least a year after six straight gains. Annual inflation eased to 12.0% in October, the overnight deposit rate is 20% after the November 1 hike, and the biggest banks raise fixed-rate certificates to 18.75% from November 8. The Monetary Policy Committee next meets on December 17.

topics.name: AI spending and chip stocks

topics.name: US midterms
topics.now: Democrats won control of Congress in the November 3 midterms. President Trump named Stephen Miller White House chief of staff after Susie Wiles resigned on November 5, and the new Congress convenes in January.
